title: 当你老了

sections.evidence: Page 1 Systems 0-1 (mm 0-7). Printed margin label '前奏'. 8-bar instrumental intro in 6/8 time.
Page 1 Systems 2-3 (mm 8-16). Printed margin label '主歌1'. Pickup bar m8 ('弱起 5 3'), followed by 8 bars: '当你老了 头发白了 睡意昏沉'. 9 bars total.
Page 1 Systems 4-5 (mm 17-25). Printed margin label '主歌2'. Pickup bar m17 ('弱起 5 3'), followed by 8 bars: '当你老了 走不动了 炉火旁打盹 回忆青春'. 9 bars total.
Page 1 Systems 6-7 (mm 26-33). Printed margin label '副歌1'. Chorus 1: '多少人曾爱你青春欢畅的时辰 爱慕你的美丽 假意或真心'. 8 bars.
Page 1 Systems 8-9 (mm 34-41). Printed margin label '副歌2'. Chorus 2: '只有一个人还爱你虔诚的灵魂 爱你苍老的脸上的皱纹'. 8 bars.
Page 2 Systems 10-11 (mm 42-50). Printed margin label '主歌1' on 唯美版. Pickup bar m42 + 8 bars. 9 bars total.
Page 2 Systems 12-13 (mm 51-59). Printed margin label '主歌2' on 唯美版. Pickup bar m51 + 8 bars. 9 bars total.
Page 2 Systems 14-15 (mm 60-67). Printed margin label '副歌1' on 唯美版. 8 bars.
Page 2 Systems 16-17 (mm 68-75). Printed margin label '副歌2' on 唯美版. 8 bars.

uncertain: Page 2 is an alternate simplified version (唯美版) without intro, appended as page 2. Annotations map both pages to global measure indices 0-75.
notes: Page 1 (mm 0-41) is 专业版; Page 2 (mm 42-75) is 唯美版. All section labels are explicitly printed in the score margins.
